title: Nursing Officers and Clinical Officers
description:
Aspin Drug Stores is a leading pharmaceutical and healthcare services provider committed to delivering quality, accessible, and affordable healthcare to communities across Uganda. We are expanding our team and invite qualified professionals to apply for the following positions.

**Available Positions**

**1. Nursing Officers**
- **Qualification:** Degree or Diploma in Nursing
- **Experience:** Degree holders require a minimum of 1 year of post-registration experience; Diploma holders require a minimum of 5 years of post-registration experience
- **Key Responsibilities:**
  - Providing compassionate, patient-centered nursing care
  - Administering medications and monitoring patient responses
  - Maintaining accurate and up-to-date patient health records
  - Conducting patient and community health education sessions
  - Collaborating with clinical officers and pharmacists for holistic patient management
  - Ensuring compliance with infection prevention and control standards

**2. Clinical Officers**
- **Qualification:** Diploma in Clinical Medicine from a recognized institution
- **Experience:** Minimum of 1 year of clinical practice
- **Key Responsibilities:**
  - Diagnosing and managing common medical conditions
  - Prescribing appropriate medications and treatments
  - Referring patients to higher-level facilities when necessary
  - Maintaining clinical documentation and patient records
  - Participating in community outreach and health education programs
  - Adhering to professional codes of conduct and ethical standards

**About Aspin Drug Stores**
Aspin Drug Stores operates a network of pharmacies and clinics across Uganda, providing pharmaceutical retail, clinical services, and health advisory support. Our mission is to make quality healthcare accessible to every community we serve.

**What We Offer**
- Competitive remuneration packages
- Opportunities for professional development and continuous medical education
- A supportive and collaborative work environment
- Exposure to diverse clinical cases and patient populations
- Career growth within a expanding healthcare network

**ClinicPesa Special Offer**
For ClinicPesa customers: Dial *165*44# on MTN to create an account and enjoy a 20% discount at any of our stores.
